subject: Demo video + further details - Encord
text:
Hi Pietro,

Just sending through that short demo video for you to show Matteo. Thought
I'd also reiterate some of the details that Olivia sent through after our
introductory call last week.

As MiCROTEC expands into new use cases and integrates it's 3D pipeline,
Encord can support you through a common inflection point - where internal
tooling alone starts to introduce structural friction at scale. Issues
start to arise as specialist teams become harder to orchestrate across
regions, growing data volumes put strain on custom tools, and modalities
increase in complexity.

It is at this stage where many teams decide to deploy Encord. Not to
replace your specialist expertise; but to provide the streamlined
infrastructure required to make that expertise scalable, reliable, and
collaborative across distributed teams.

Specific capabilities for MiCROTEC:

   - Future-Proof Ingestion: Handle 2D and 3D data natively in one
   platform. No need to rebuild pipelines or spin up silos for new modalities.
   - Smart curation: Utilise embeddings to prioritise complex edge-cases on
   boards instantly.
   - Automated efficiency: Deploy pre-labelling (MITL) for complex defects
   to cut manual labelling time.
   - Streamlined Ops: A single pane of glass for cross-region workflow
   orchestration, QA, and permissions that non-engineers can easily manage.
   - Measurable ROI: rigorous analytics and audit trails to prove
   efficiency gains and track defect-specific model improvements.

Below I will attach a link to the short demo video that you asked for.
Fundamentally, it will show you what our annotation workflows can look like
at a high level. The flexible workflow allows you to assign specific tasks
/ stages to specific annotators / reviewers, as well as integrate agents to
assist with pre-labelling. This then allows you access the analytics
dashboards and audit trails that help you to measure efficiency and QA. It
will also show the SAM 2 capabilities that we have in the annotation suite
(SAM 3 also integrated).
